summary: Iteration 6 testing (password reset via Resend + Emergent Google Auth). Backend: 13/13 pytest tests passed (forgot-password known/unknown/invalid email, Resend delivery with fallback to DIGEST_EMAIL, reset-password bad/expired/wrong-type/short-password rejections, valid-token reset with auto-login cookies + old-password 401 + new-password 200, emergent-session invalid 401 & missing field 422, login/me + /api/config regression). Frontend: /login shows email/password form, 'или' divider, google-signin button, link-forgot, Регистрация; Google button navigates to https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=https%3A%2F%2F<host>%2Fauth%2Fcallback (verified via navigation log, OAuth not completed); /forgot-password submit shows 'Проверьте почту.' + working 'Вернуться ко входу'; /reset-password?token=INVALID shows 'Пароли не совпадают.' client-side then 'Неверный токен восстановления.' in reset-error; valid token from backend log resets password, auto-logs-in and lands on dashboard; /auth/callback with no hash and with #session_id=invalid both redirect to /login with error toast. Admin password verified back at 'admin1234' (API login 200).

minor.issue: No rate limiting — endpoint can be hit repeatedly for the same email (email-bombing / Resend quota burn). Consider per-email cooldown.

Reset token is a stateless JWT and is NOT invalidated after use; the same link can be replayed for a full hour (verified reusable). Consider storing a jti/password_changed_at and rejecting used tokens.
No brute-force lockout after repeated failed logins (playbook item 4) — unlimited 401 attempts allowed.

action_items: Optional hardening: single-use reset tokens (invalidate after password change)
critical_code_review_comments: Reset tokens are replayable within their 1h TTL — add password_changed_at check in reset_password to invalidate older tokens.

Resend test mode rejects non-owner recipients; fallback to DIGEST_EMAIL works and is logged, but in production the loop would silently email the fallback address if the real send fails for any reason (e.g. transient error) — consider only using fallback when the error is the test-mode restriction.
server.py is 1323 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth, lectures, tests, digest).
seed_data_creation: None. Admin password was temporarily changed to TESTreset9876 during the valid-reset test and restored to admin1234 (verified login 200).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run new iter6 suite with `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_iteration6_reset.py -n 0` (pytest.ini forces xdist; -n 0 needed for sequential password-reset tests). Reset tokens can be pulled from /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log via regex '\[reset\] link for .*token=([A-Za-z0-9._-]+)'. Resend always fails to admin@upsidestudy.app (test-mode) and succeeds to workspace67676752@gmail.com — expected. Google OAuth cannot be completed end-to-end; only the redirect URL and the 401 path for invalid session_id were verified.
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found. Password reset + Emergent session endpoints and all four new/updated frontend pages behave as specified.
